result:
The four Modular-entry operations and the Modular G3 precondition are in place, and every required check exits 0. One part is incomplete: the waiver half of "rejected until supplied or waived" cannot be used through the API. The orchestrator needs to decide how to fix it.

I did not use gate exceptions for the waiver, as the assignment asked, because a gate exception must cover one of G3's existing criteria. None of those is about baselines or outcome links, so counting any G3 exception as a waiver would skip a check nobody waived. I implemented the D-106 wording instead: an accepted, unexpired G3 waiver dispensation. The existing DG3 route refuses to create such a waiver for a Modular transformation, so today it can only exist as test data. The handback (§0.2) gives three options for you to choose from.

**Endpoints added** (all in `reporting/modular.ts`):
- `GET /api/v1/transformations/{id}/missing-links` lists blocking and warning items and labels G1–G6. A gate shows `approved` only when the platform approved it; an inherited approval shows `inherited`.
- `GET …/inherited-records` lists inherited evidence and baselines, plus prior approvals as read-only `prior_approval` entries. Every entry is labelled `inherited` ("Inherited - recorded, not granted in platform").
- `POST …/inherited-records` records evidence or a baseline. It refuses End-to-End transformations (422 `inherited_record.not_modular`) and kind `prior_approval` (422 `inherited_record.prior_approval_use_dispensation`).
- `POST …/inherited-records/{id}/withdraw` requires `If-Match`.
- My pending list went from 4 operations to 0. No gate decision is written and no gate status changes.

**The G3 rule:** a Modular G3 with its own criteria met but no baseline and no outcome link gets 422 `gate.modular_links_missing`, listing `/baseline` and `/outcomes`. Once both are supplied it gets 201, and an accepted waiver also gets 201.

**End-to-End responses are unchanged.** I recorded 21 End-to-End G1–G4 responses (refusals, submissions, decisions and the gate list) with my code and again with the base commit's `gates.ts`. After replacing ids and timestamps, the two recordings are byte-identical.

**Two deviations from ADR-0038 §7.4:**
- **Check order:** the check runs after the criteria check, not before. An existing DG2 test (`dg2-repairs.test.ts:461`) expects a Modular G3 without links to answer `gate_criteria_incomplete`; this order keeps that response and every other existing refusal unchanged.
- **Scope:** the rule applies to G3 only, as D-106 says, not to the wider set of gates in the ADR.

**Other open items:**
- The G3 gate view still shows `canSubmit: true` when only the links are missing; changing that was outside my files.
- `createInheritedRecord` returns a `Location` for which the contract has no read operation.
- One new code, `inherited_record.record_not_found`, plus new per-item message texts. The Arabic label is provisional.
- The media-type pin in `contract.test.ts` rose by 2, from `[304,303,1]` to `[306,305,1]`.

**Migrations:** none needed. Changes are left uncommitted.

**Checks (all exit 0):**

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG3` (start and end) | PASS |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check | pass |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | PASS, 647 operations |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | 2352 passed (+10), and 259 passed / 2 skipped, in both |
| `with-pg.sh pnpm test:integration` (ports 25100–25149) | 163 files, 1603 passed (+16) |

Several runs failed before these final ones, all fixed: fixture mistakes in my new tests, two code-style violations caught by the module-boundary check, and the media-type pin. The handback lists each one and keeps the logs that survived.

The handback is `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG4/T-DG4-BE-M2-backend-workflow-engineer.md`; logs and recordings are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG4/T-DG4-BE-M2-evidence/`.
